titulo: Online booking: no more back-and-forth texts
hooks: Booking appointments by text all day?
Your calendar can fill up while you sleep
voz: Got anything this afternoon? How about Thursday? Anything later? Every appointment booked by text is a back-and-forth that eats your afternoon. With online booking, your customer sees the open slots, picks one and gets a reminder. You find out when it's already booked.

items: You forget to write it down

captions: Every appointment you book by text comes with a bunch of back-and-forth: what day, what time, anything later. With online booking, your customer picks and you get to focus on the work.
Online booking also sends your customer a reminder, so fewer people forget and you end up with fewer gaps in your calendar.
Salons, clinics, studios, auto shops: any business that runs on appointments saves time when customers book themselves.
